gate_rules.independent_success_rule: Count a cold item correct only on its first unprompted attempt with frozen response mode and exact expected answer or selection ID.
gate_rules.advance_rule: Advance after at least 6 of 8 cold items are independently correct; presentation models are never scored.
gate_rules.train_more_trigger: Release TRAIN_MORE when fewer than 6 of 8 cold items are independently correct.
gate_rules.post_train_more_rule: After reserve release, re-evaluate the latest eight independently attempted scored items against the same 0.75 rule; stop for author review if unmet.

train_more.return_rule: Return to the same gate and retest failed base targets; reserves are fresh practice only and never count as cold evidence.

train_longer.decision_rule: Release TRAIN_LONGER only when the initial mixed score is below 26/32; administer exactly 8 additional mixed items (denominator 8), one per label and exactly two per family.
train_longer.stop_rule: Score exactly 8 items (8-item denominator); success at 7/8 ends TRAIN_LONGER, while failure terminates with defer_and_revisit.

alarm_conditions: any spoken instruction, question, article, copula, yes/no word, or sentence form appears
any mismatch lacks an explicit visible wrong label and unique replacement
